seo.title: Free digital help for everyday problems
seo.description: A free place to ask for help with digital problems. Simple, clear, and made for people who do not want jargon.
seo.keywords: free digital help, tech help, online support, simple support, help with internet problems

title: Free digital help, kept simple
subtitle: If something online is getting in your way, you can send it here in plain words.
freeNote: This service is free for now.

sections.whatItIsBody: This is a simple place for people who need help with digital things: a website, email, a login, a form, a device, or another small internet problem.
sections.whatToSendBody: Use short, clear words. Tell me what is happening, what you expected, and what device or site is involved.
sections.howItWorksBody: You send one request. I read requests daily. If I can help, I reply by email. If I need more detail, I will ask one follow-up question.
sections.responseTitle: When you can expect a reply
sections.responseBody: I try to answer within one to two days. If the request is unclear or needs more context, it may take a little longer because I will ask for clarification first.
sections.limitsBody: This is not live chat, not spam, and not a place for random sales messages. Please send one real problem at a time.
examples: My email will not open on my phone.
I cannot log into a website I used before.
A form keeps showing an error and I do not know why.
